title: Plasma Ball Fantasy
description: A glowing plasma ball with a central purple orb emitting bright blue and pink electrical arcs. Inside the glass sphere are four dragonflies, a stylized purple heart with blue lips, and swirling colorful hair patterns against a desert mountain backdrop.
prompt: A surreal plasma ball sitting on a worn metallic base, the glass sphere contains a glowing purple central orb shooting bright blue and pink lightning arcs. Four detailed dragonflies fly around inside. On the right side is a large stylized purple heart with blue lips and swirling colorful hair patterns. Faint desert mountains and green mist are visible in the background of the sphere. Dark purple atmospheric background, vibrant glowing aesthetic.
